title: feat(analytics): Push pagination
body:
<!--
  Thanks for submitting a pull request!
  Please provide enough information so that others can review your pull request.
-->

**Summary**

Currently the analytics widget doesn't trigger `pushFunction` during pagination. This PR adds a parameter to allow the `pushFunction` to be triggered there.

**Result**

`pushFunction` can be triggered on pagination 🎉
